description: This file implements a diffcore rotate operation, manipulating a queue of diff objects to rotate the diff order based on a specified path. It includes logic for finding a target path within the diff queue and rearranging the queue accordingly.

methods.name: void diffcore_rotate(struct diff_options * opt)
methods.description: Performs a rotation of the diff queue based on a target path specified in the options, rearranging the order of diffs accordingly.
